entries.title: Psalms 140:1
segments:
PSALM CXL. 
 
  David prays and hopes for deliverance from his enemies, ver. 1-7.   Foretells their destruction, ver. 8-13.   To the chief musician, A psalm of David.

entries.title: Psalms 140:3
segments: V. 3. Tongues-Using words as sharp and piercing as the sting of a serpent.

entries.title: Psalms 140:9
segments: V. 9. Mischief-The mischief which they design against me, shall fall upon themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 140:10
segments: V. 10. Coals-Divine vengeance, which is compared to coals of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 140:13
segments: V. 13. Dwell-Shall constantly enjoy thy gracious and powerful presence.
